sources.title: Visa regime for citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.officialityEvidence: Kazakhstan MFA publishes this live passport-type table on the official government gov.kz domain and expressly distinguishes ordinary passports from diplomatic and service/official passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: D – diplomatic passport; S – service/official passport; N – ordinary passport.

policies.title: Kazakhstan ordinary passport: Tunisia visa-free up to 90 days
policies.summary: Kazakhstan MFA's current N (ordinary-passport) column expressly records Tunisia as visa-free up to 90 days.
conditions: The cited ordinary-passport table gives a maximum visa-free stay of 90 days; it does not establish residence, employment, study, transit, crew or special-document rights.
The table does not displace destination documentary, health, security, carrier or final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Kazakhstan ordinary passport: Ukraine visa-free up to 90 days
policies.summary: Kazakhstan MFA's current N (ordinary-passport) column expressly records Ukraine as visa-free up to 90 days.
conditions: The cited ordinary-passport table gives a maximum visa-free stay of 90 days; it does not state a rolling-period calculation.
This candidate maps only the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline. It does not establish treatment for study, work, residence, transit, diplomatic/service or special documents.
Border accessibility, martial-law measures, documentary, security and individual final-admission rules remain outside this nationality visa classification.
